parts.name: Popover
parts.description: A portalled Radix popover anchored to one trigger element. Positioning, dismissal and focus callbacks apply to the content element.

props.name: trigger
props.description: One ref-capable action element used as the popover trigger.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the popover content.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when opening or closing is requested.

props.name: modal
props.description: Trap focus and disable outside interaction while open.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Render the decorative arrow pointing to the trigger.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred placement side; collision handling can choose another side.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and content.

props.name: align
props.description: Preferred alignment relative to the trigger.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Pixel offset from the selected alignment.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance in pixels between the arrow and the content corners.

props.name: avoidCollisions
props.description: Adjust placement to keep content within the collision boundary.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: Element or elements used as the placement boundary; omitted uses the viewport.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Pixel padding inside the collision boundary, globally or per side.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Radix sticky-placement strategy: partial or always.

props.name: hideWhenDetached
props.description: Hide content when its anchor is detached from the visible boundary.

props.name: updatePositionStrategy
props.description: Reposition with the optimized or always strategy.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the Radix content mounted for externally managed visibility or animation. The consumer must manage its closed presentation.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called before Escape dismisses the surface; prevent default to keep it open.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Called for a pointer press outside the content; prevent default to cancel dismissal.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Called when focus moves outside the content; prevent default to cancel the associated outside interaction.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.type: ((event: CustomEvent<{ originalEvent: PointerEvent; }> | CustomEvent<{ originalEvent: FocusEvent; }>) => void)
props.description: Called for pointer or focus interaction outside the content; prevent default to cancel dismissal.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Called before focus enters opened content; prevent default to choose the focus target.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Called before focus returns after closing; prevent default when navigation manages focus.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: PopoverClose
parts.description: Closes the nearest matching overlay. Use asChild with one ref-capable action element, or render the default native button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
